name: Adessa Mind
line: The clinic system behind the Adessa Quotient.
summary: Adessa Mind's assessment pulls together cognitive tasks, heart rate variability and brain data. We built the AQ Platform to run the whole visit: it runs the tasks, reads the HeartMath and WAVi reports, scores the AQ, presents it to the client and hands the Activation plan to the technician. Every number traces back to its source.
includes: Assessment tasks, report import, scoring engine, client reports, Ask Adessa, staff console
before: Consent and a short check-in, full screen to the end
Flanker, Numbers, Copying and Matrix Reasoning, scored as each finishes
HeartMath HRT report uploaded and read
AQ scored and saved, with every step shown
Ring reveal, report export and technician brief
system: Clients and sessions, four team roles enforced on the server, an audit trail on every change, and plans, memberships and revenue.
Eight domains in two rings. Each is a weighted mix of its inputs, and every weight change is versioned.
Flanker, Numbers, Copying and Matrix Reasoning, with millisecond timing and seeded trials.
Reads HeartMath HRT and WAVi PDFs, plus past AQ reports so returning clients keep their history.
A Claude assistant trained on the clinic's own material. It also drafts client reports, which staff check before saving.
28 SOPs and walkthroughs, a test mode and a phone layout.
run: generated AQ with every step shown
results: SOPs and walkthroughs in the staff guide
note: The AQ is a non-diagnostic measure of current cognitive state, for informational and wellness purposes only.

name: Art of Practice
line: A cohort program that runs without the founder in every thread.
summary: Enrollment, cohort setup and member questions were all handled by hand. We wrote the playbook for opening a cohort and built three agents to run it, so the founder teaches instead of administering.
includes: Enrollment, cohort ops and member support agents
before: Every cohort set up from scratch
Member questions answered one by one
system: How a cohort opens, runs and closes, step by step, so anyone on the team can run it.
Pulls paid enrollments into one roster and keeps it current.
Sets up the member space and calendar and schedules every live session.
Drafts welcome emails and answers common member questions from the FAQ.
run: answered member questions from the faq

name: Element Glo
line: Five lead capture tools for an aggregate brand.
summary: Buyers, retailers and builders all needed answers before they would order. We built five tools that answer those questions on the site and capture the lead while they do it.
includes: Aggregate visualizer, aggregate calculator, store display maker, mosaic layout planner, builder bidding tool
before: Buyers guess how much aggregate to order
Customers can't picture the finished look
Store displays laid out one at a time
Builders price every job from scratch
system: Lets buyers see how the aggregate looks before they order.
Works out how much aggregate a project needs and turns the estimate into a lead.
Helps retail partners plan in-store displays.
Plans mosaic patterns and the material each one needs.
Helps builders price jobs that use the aggregate and send bids faster.
run: sent estimate and design to the lead

name: Fit Funnels
line: Client launches for a fitness marketing team, on rails.
summary: Each new gym client meant a week of setup and a checklist nobody could find. We turned launch into a written system and built agents for onboarding, pre-launch checks and the weekly report.
includes: Onboarding, launch QA and reporting agents
before: Onboarding calls repeat the same questions
Weekly reports built by hand on Friday
system: One written process for taking a new gym client from signed to live.
Sends the intake form and asset request and chases anything missing.
Checks pages, forms and tracking before anything goes live.
Builds the weekly client report from campaign data.
run: sent intake form and asset request

name: Jason Stephenson
line: Publishing and inbox ops for a meditation creator.
summary: A large audience means a steady stream of releases, messages and licensing requests. We wrote down the release pipeline and built agents that prep each drop, sort the inbox and route licensing requests to the right person.
before: Every release prepped by hand per platform
Fans, partners and spam share one inbox
system: Every step of a release, from final audio to scheduled posts, written down.
Preps titles, descriptions and tags and queues each release across channels.
Sorts messages into fans, partners and everything else.
Routes licensing requests with standard terms to the right person.

name: MaWa!
line: Launch ops for a matcha water brand.
summary: A beverage launch runs on store outreach, orders and investor updates at the same time. We built the launch system and agents that work the retail pipeline, reconcile orders and draft the monthly update.
includes: Retail, orders and investor update agents
system: The weekly rhythm for retail outreach, orders and investor updates.
Tracks the store pipeline and follows up with open accounts.
Reconciles orders and payouts as they come in.
Drafts the monthly update from the month's numbers and notes.
